_about: Prorated first-month rent for an online move-in, which the move-in page and the server must both price to the cent: the page sends its total and createPublicMoveInCheckout refuses one that differs from its own.

at is the instant priced from: a renter's chosen move-in date, or, with none chosen, the moment checkout runs. Each case is priced from the UTC calendar date of that instant; the time of day does not matter.

days is the move-in day through the last day of its month, both counted; amount is monthlyRate / daysInMonth * days, rounded to cents from the exact value (Dart's toStringAsFixed(2), JavaScript's toFixed(2)).

The app side runs each case through ProrateService (test/move_in_proration_parity_test.dart), both as a chosen date parsed from its ISO string and as a no-date move-in priced at that moment on the browser's own clock.
The server side runs each case through calculateProratedRent and computePublicMoveInCharges (functions-public-website/src/test/moveInCharges.test.ts).

cases.name: mid-month at midnight UTC bills the 15th through the 30th
mid-month at 20:00 UTC bills the same 16 days
the last millisecond of the day still bills that day
the last day of a 30-day month at 20:00 bills one day, not nothing
the last day of a 31-day month at 20:00 bills one day
the last day of the year bills one day of December
the first day at midnight bills the whole month
the first day at 20:00 bills the whole month
February in a common year is 28 days
28 February in a common year bills one day
February in a leap year is 29 days
mid-February in a leap year bills the 15th through the 29th
29 February bills one day
a month with a daylight-saving change bills whole days
the first of a daylight-saving month bills the whole month
8pm on 15 Sep in US Central is 16 Sep in UTC, so 16-30 Sep is billed
the same moment written with its UTC offset prices the same
10pm on 30 Sep in US Pacific is 1 Oct in UTC, so all of October is billed
a half cent rounds from the exact value: 10.01 / 30 * 15 is 5.00
a half cent rounds from the exact value: 10.01 / 28 * 2 is 0.71
a rate with cents over part of a month
a rate too small to come to a cent for one day bills nothing
